title: TALOS - RESTAURANT COST MANAGEMENT
description: Restaurant owners were costing every dish in Excel and still guessing their margins. This desktop app prices each dish, keeps warehouse stock in sync with every recipe, and flags the menu items that lose money.
impact: Shipped and in daily use — hours of spreadsheet food-costing become minutes.

title: ATLAS - SAAS ANALYTICS DASHBOARD
description: Admin dashboards get slow as the data grows. This one holds 50,000 customer accounts and two years of revenue history, and every filter and sort answers in under 15 ms. Ask it why revenue moved — typed or spoken — and a Gemini-backed assistant answers from the numbers on screen, then works the dashboard for you: changes the window, filters the table to the accounts it just named, exports the view.
impact: Speed you can check yourself: frame rate and filter cost are measured live in the app. The assistant is held to the same standard — it answers only from the data on screen, quotes each figure exactly as the tile beside it does, and keeps working when the model is unreachable.

title: MILLENIA BANK WEB APPLICATION
description: A complete online banking interface: accounts, cards, a guided three-step transfer with real IBAN validation, and a searchable statement you can export to CSV. Light and dark, English and Greek.
impact: Rebuilt from a 2022 version down to an 84 kB first load — no UI library, every chart drawn by hand.

title: PERCH - HOTEL SEARCH
description: Hotel search that opens in about a second, even on a phone on mobile data. 180 properties, a two-month date picker, a live map, and every filter saved into the link so a guest can share exactly what they found.
impact: 17 kB on first load, roughly a twentieth of a typical React site, with the map downloaded only when someone opens it.

title: ECOMMERCE PLATFORM
description: A shop and its back office in one build: customers browse, review and check out, while the owner runs catalogue, stock, orders and discount codes from the same admin.
impact: Angular front end on a real Express/SQLite API with JWT auth — the operator half of e-commerce that most demos skip.

title: WEATHER NOW - ANGULAR PWA
description: Weather answered in one glance — live conditions and a 7-day forecast for any city, installable to a phone home screen like a real app and still readable with no connection.
impact: The sky behind the numbers is drawn in SVG and animated with GSAP: sun, clouds, rain, snow and lightning all react to the actual forecast.

title: BROWSER EXTENSION MANAGER UI
description: Extension manager with All / Active / Inactive filtering, search, sort, bulk actions and undoable removal — cards glide between grid positions instead of snapping when a filter changes.
impact: A Frontend Mentor challenge rebuilt as a real app: zoneless Angular, a signal store, and GSAP Flip driving the layout transitions.

title: TACET - SCROLL-DRIVEN PRODUCT LANDING PAGE
description: A product page that plays like a film: the background video advances frame by frame as you scroll, sections pin into place, and the entire brand — logo, copy, video, 3D — was generated with AI.
impact: Concept to live site in two days, for launches that need to look expensive on a short deadline.

title: ADD RECYCLING - CORPORATE WEBSITE
description: An electronics recycling company had no website at all. Now it has a bilingual Greek/English site that explains its e-scrap, cable and catalytic converter services and turns visitors into quote requests.
impact: First online presence for a physical business — bilingual, SEO-ready, built to bring in enquiries.

title: CAFFÈ ANDANTE - BILINGUAL CAFÉ LANDING PAGE
description: Everything a neighbourhood café needs on one page, in Greek and English: menu, photo gallery, weekly programme, booking form, and a badge showing whether it is open right now.
impact: A template any local business can take over — every price, fact and photo swaps out in a single pass.

title: CONFERENCE TICKET GENERATOR
description: Sign-up flow that issues a personalised event ticket: drag and drop a photo, fill in your details, and get back a ticket carrying your name, avatar and ticket number.
impact: Form validation and file upload in plain JavaScript, including the error states most demos skip.
